items.title: Polymarket US Sues Ohio to Block Sports-Contract Crackdown
items.summary: The exchange seeks preliminary and permanent injunctions after Ohio demanded an immediate halt to sports contracts and written confirmation of compliance by Oct.

items.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent likens GENIUS Act to Lincoln-era banking reform
items.summary: The OCC has finalized rules for stablecoin reserves and redemptions, with Bessent calling the GENIUS Act a “watershed moment for American finance.”

items.title: Dogecoin Gets a Dedicated Company to Build Out Its Ecosystem
items.summary: Formed with the Dogecoin Foundation and led by MyDoge founder Jordan Jefferson, the new company consolidates the MyDoge wallet, DogeOS app platform, and Such App to build an economy around DOGE.

items.title: Dataline raises $10.6 million for decentralized data network for AI agents, plans ICO
items.summary: The startup also plans to hold a public token sale through Uniswap's auction platform, with details expected next week.
